Summary: One Star

First, you should be using Google Chrome (because it is awesome).

Second, download BetterTouchTool (free) by Googling it. (I would provide the link here but Amazon doesn't allow external links in their reviews.) Unzip it and put the executable file somewhere that it won't be deleted, such as your Documents folder. Open BetterTouchTool. From the choice of devices choose "Normal Mice".

On the left side, under "Select Application" click the plus (+) button. Select Google Chrome from your Applications. Now, you will find a full list of Mac keyboard shortcuts for Chrome here by Googling "chrome mac keyboard shortcuts".

You will see on that list that the keyboard shortcut to go back is -[ and to go forward is -]. So in BetterTouchTool, click "+ Add New Button" then hover your mouse over "Click here to select mouse button" and press your mouse button 3 on your Anker mouse. Then in the custom keyboard shortcut field enter the -[ combo. Repeat the setup for mouse button 4 and forward shortcut -]. (Additionally I used this to set the middle mouse button to toggle full screen mode, which is keyboard shortcut -Shift-F.)

Important: In BetterTouchTool's settings, you'll also want to enable "Launch BetterTouchTool on startup".

When you're done, close BetterTouchTool. I mean completely Quit it and restart it. I found that if you don't restart it, it doesn't work the first time. Alright now you should be all set to use the forward, back, and middle mouse button to your heart's desire.

I would have given this mouse a 5 star if the buttons worked on a Mac without a workaround like this, but I'm very happy with the mouse with the BetterTouchTool solution.

Hope this helps all you Mac owners out there.
